title: [Linux/Wayland] window_set_position() causes incorrect mouse position reporting
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: v4.7.stable.official [5b4e0cb0f]




### System information

Godot v4.7.stable - Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS 24.04 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Ryzen 7 7700X 8-Core Processor (radeonsi, raphael_mendocino, LLVM 20.1.8, DRM 3.64, 6.17.0-35-generic) - AMD Ryzen 7 7700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 30.31 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

- `get_viewport().get_mouse_position()` and `get_global_mouse_position()` return coordinates relative to the pre-move window origin after calling `DisplayServer.window_set_position()` on Linux (X11 display server under XWayland)
- Behavior is correct on Windows and Mac with identical project settings

### Steps to reproduce

1. Setup an empty Node2D main scene with a Camera2D node set to 2.0 x and y zoom
2. Attach this gdscript to the scene, run the project, and click the window a couple times (it will move back and forth between its default position and up and to the left 100px while outputting debug prints to the console)
```
extends Node2D

var window_default_pos: Vector2i
var window_toggle_pos: Vector2i

func _ready():
	window_default_pos = DisplayServer.window_get_position()
	window_toggle_pos = Vector2i(window_default_pos.x - 100, window_default_pos.y - 100)
	print("[debug] platform=%s session=%s display_server=%s" % [
		OS.get_name(),
		OS.get_environment("XDG_SESSION_TYPE"),
		DisplayServer.get_name(),
	])

func _input(e) -> void:
	if e is InputEventMouseButton and e.button_index == MouseButton.MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT and e.pressed:
		print("--------------")
		print_pos()
		toggle_window_pos()
		print_pos()

func is_default_pos() -> bool:
	return DisplayServer.window_get_position() == window_default_pos

func toggle_window_pos() -> void:
	if is_default_pos():
		DisplayServer.window_set_position(window_toggle_pos)
	else:
		DisplayServer.window_set_position(window_default_pos)

func print_pos() -> void:
	var prefix = "WINDOW_DEFAULT" if is_default_pos() else "WINDOW_MOVED"
	var godot_local = get_viewport().get_mouse_position()
	var os_local = DisplayServer.mouse_get_position() - DisplayServer.window_get_position()
	var godot_global = get_global_mouse_position()
	var os_global := get_viewport().canvas_transform.affine_inverse() * Vector2(os_local)
	print("%s \t godot_local=%s os_local=%s \t godot_global=%s os_global=%s" % [prefix, godot_local, os_local, godot_global, os_global])
```

2. On Linux/Wayland, my WINDOW_MOVED godot local and global mouse positions are off by the 100px the window moved from its default origin (aka they remain unchanged because it's not accounting for the moved window at all). The os local and global mouse positions manually calculated do not have this issue and correctly show the 100px difference between the original and moved window positions. For example:
```
OpenGL API 4.6 (Core Profile) Mesa 25.3.1 - kisak-mesa PPA - Compatibility - Using Device: AMD - AMD Ryzen 7 7700X 8-Core Processor (radeonsi, raphael_mendocino, LLVM 20.1.8, DRM 3.64, 6.17.0-35-generic)

[debug] platform=Linux session=wayland display_server=X11
--------------
WINDOW_DEFAULT 	 godot_local=(198.0, 182.0) os_local=(198, 182) 	 godot_global=(24.0, 16.0) os_global=(24.0, 16.0)
WINDOW_MOVED 	 godot_local=(198.0, 182.0) os_local=(298, 282) 	 godot_global=(24.0, 16.0) os_global=(74.0, 66.0)
--------------
WINDOW_MOVED 	 godot_local=(106.0, 120.0) os_local=(206, 220) 	 godot_global=(-22.0, -15.0) os_global=(28.0, 35.0)
WINDOW_DEFAULT 	 godot_local=(106.0, 120.0) os_local=(106, 120) 	 godot_global=(-22.0, -15.0) os_global=(-22.0, -15.0)
```

On Windows & Mac, the moved window position is always properly accounted for by godot when returning the mouse positions (aka no desync between godot and os positions). For example:
```
Godot Engine v4.7.stable.official.5b4e0cb0f - https://godotengine.org
OpenGL API 4.1 Metal - 90.5 - Compatibility - Using Device: Apple - Apple M1

[debug] platform=macOS session= display_server=macOS
--------------
WINDOW_DEFAULT      godot_local=(163.0, 100.0) os_local=(163, 100)      godot_global=(6.5, -25.0) os_global=(6.5, -25.0)
WINDOW_MOVED      godot_local=(263.0, 200.0) os_local=(263, 200)      godot_global=(56.5, 25.0) os_global=(56.5, 25.0)
--------------
WINDOW_MOVED      godot_local=(263.0, 200.0) os_local=(263, 200)      godot_global=(56.5, 25.0) os_global=(56.5, 25.0)
WINDOW_DEFAULT      godot_local=(163.0, 100.0) os_local=(163, 100)      godot_global=(6.5, -25.0) os_global=(6.5, -25.0)
```
